answer.rationale: Incumbent price is closed this cycle, so renew and further negotiation cannot hit the 18% spend cut. The low-cost quote meets the mandate on its own; memory_c2 reports a prior primary move to that vendor with fast onboarding and accurate invoicing, which is the only path that can cut unit cost in time. memory_c1 however shows incumbent renewal protected integration and uninterrupted deliveries. With the line at 94% and no buffer, a full cutover would raise delivery risk and TCO if onboarding is slower than remembered, so any switch stays a small guarded test and last year's smoothness is not treated as certain until the archive is checked. Deferral is unsafe because the contract expires in 14 days without auto-renewal; a second source would not by itself deliver the mandated cut.
